result.summary: Not ready to dispatch: the prescribed removal accounting contradicts the required empty-shelf compatibility.

findings.title: Preserve removal accounting when empty shelf directories are deleted
findings.body: X1 requires pushing every successful rmdir into `removed`. With both shelf directories empty, this reports redacted, quarantine and state, whereas the baseline reports only state. A mocked execution confirmed the two-item difference. The existing uninstall caller sums `removed.length`, so its final count changes, violating W6 and acceptance criterion 7's byte-identical output requirement. Rendering that expanded list also changes the dry-run plan. The specified algorithm and acceptance contract cannot both hold as written.
findings.recommendation: Keep internal rmdir bookkeeping separate from the public `removed` array. Specify reporting at the original mechanics-directory granularity, and verify complete live and dry-run output with both shelf roots present but empty.

next_steps: Reconcile X1's return accounting with W6 before implementation.
